description: Upcoming Greater Boston events from The Boston Calendar. Defaults to a 2-week window from today. Filter by date range, keyword (title/description/tags), and free admission. Returns normalized events sorted by date/time.

free_only.description: If true, only events whose admission is free.

query.description: Keyword filter over title, description, and tags, e.g. "free music", "kids", "art".

to.description: Latest event date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 14 days from `from`). Pass "" for no upper bound.

name: events
title: Events
